selection_split: v1 dev only (old test diagnostic only)
selection: maximize dev Recall@5 among candidates with MRR@10 and nDCG@5 >= legacy hybrid; tie: nDCG, MRR, canonical config JSON
holdout: 60 independent newly authored answerable questions; one evaluation after config/code/corpus frozen; no retuning
uncertainty: paired question bootstrap and cluster bootstrap by author topic groups; report recall, MRR, nDCG and all regressions
changes_excluded: no embeddings, corpus, labels, FTS SQL or chunker changes
